title: CMSTG One-Loop Scalar Self-Energy: UV Structure and Memory Regulation
description: Compute the one-loop Psi self-energy from the Lambda0*Psi*R interaction vertex. Show (1) quartic UV divergence without memory damping; (2) finiteness with memory damping D_mem(k)=exp(-k^2/k_m^2); (3) analytic result Sigma(0) ~ Lambda0^2 * k_m^4 / (64*pi^2); (4) naturalness constraint on k_m.

theory.vertex: V(k) = Lambda0 * k^2  (from Lambda0*Psi*R in linearized gravity)
theory.memory_damping: D_mem(k) = exp(-k^2/k_m^2)  (from memory tensor commutator decay)
theory.self_energy: Sigma(p^2) = Lambda0^2 * Int d^4k/(2pi)^4 * k^2 * D_mem(k)^2 / ((p-k)^2 + m0^2)
theory.analytic_limit: Sigma(0) -> Lambda0^2 * k_m^4 / (64*pi^2)  for k_m >> m0
